platform: Mac arm64, M2 Pro, 32 GB, macOS 27
baseline: Instrumented Milestone 3: full affected-group ClearInstances + AddInstance per survivor. Uncommitted local workspace.
optimized: Native persistent ISM IDs, remove destroyed instances only; map current indices through GetInstanceIndexForId. Bulk generation, hash lookup and no duplicate layout records.
methodology: Each cycle regenerates, removes 16 singles, removes 256 unique IDs with duplicate requests, runs 32 spatial queries against a brute-force reference, applies a radius250/damage2400 explosion, clears all walls, checks every former volume for absent collision, and collects garbage. Validation, CSV logging, GC and memory snapshots excluded from operation timers. One warmup per case is excluded. Times are synchronous game-thread call wall time, including synchronous Chaos inside ISM calls; asynchronous physics, render thread and GPU are excluded. Metal window1280x720 with dynamic resolution enabled, low GI/reflection and shadow quality1, maxFPS60; CPU/frame trace enabled on that run. No FPS comparison. Total tracked memory: owned logical/layout/mapping allocations plus UE exclusive resource reports for ISM walls/floors/ceilings; not total engine heaps, shared asset/texture memory or GPU allocation. Collision body counts refer to those ISMs, excluding the fixed non-ISM foundation. Resident bytes are for the entire process and engine caches; not a block-system leak assertion.
csv_phase_convention: Normal operations: logical_ms=mutation/storage; clear_ms=ISM clear/removal including synchronous physics; add_ms=ISM insertion; mapping_ms=identity reconstruction. Explosion rows: logical_ms=spatial query; clear_ms=exposure/cover screening; add_ms=batch mutation. empty_after_gc rows are memory snapshots, not a zero-time operation benchmark.
